recentItems.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember - Official Release Date Trailer
recentItems.description:
Check out this trailer for Wo-Long 2: Wings of Ember, the sequel to Koei Tecmo and Team Ninja's popular Chinese Mythology action soulslike! 

Set during the Three Kingdoms era, during which the land is divided into three factions, with warriors fighting for their respective beliefs. Among the conflict, a warrior with the power of the phoenix arrives, crossing the battlefields to battle both man and mythical demons! 

Wo Long 2 Wings of Ember Alpha Demo is out now until September 30th, beat it to unlock the Fledgling Phoenix Helmet when Wo Long 2 Wings of Ember  releases March  4th, 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam, Xbox on PC), and Xbox Series X|S.

recentItems.title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Review
recentItems.description:
Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter reviewed by George Yang on PlayStation 5, also on PC, Nintendo Switch, and Switch 2.

"There’s never been a better time to get into the Trails series than now. Following the outstanding Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter remake, the Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter remake is just as fantastic. It captures everything that made the original so endearing, and it’s not just a fresh coat of paint. It’s a complete makeover with a polished art style and stellar voice direction that enhance its elegant storytelling and charismatic cast. It also capitalizes on over two decades worth of gameplay iterations and puts them into one action-packed yet emotional adventure. Despite a temporary lull in its penultimate act, that doesn’t stop 2nd Chapter from being a quintessential Trails game and RPG in its own right."

#IGN #Gaming

recentItems.title: Where you've seen this GTA 6 actor before
GTA 6 Soundtrack Takes Shape as Rockstar Teases Artists - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
The GTA 6 marketing blitz is well underway, starting with that extended look from two weeks ago, and now a tease of the game's soundtrack. Popular artists such as Future, Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, Raul Alejandro, and more have posted images to their social accounts featuring what appears to be art from Grand Theft Auto 6. The GTA series is known for having expansive soundtracks featuring popular artists, as well as casting those artists in voice roles in the games themselves. In other news, 007: First Light on Switch 2 has been delayed yet again, this time all the way to March 2027. The PC, PS5, and Xbox versions debuted back in May of this year. And finally, the art director for Apex Legends explains how this new Street Fighter collab gave the existing characters 'thick thighs.'

recentItems.title: Gallipoli Review
recentItems.description:
Gallipoli reviewed by Seth Macy on PC.

"Gallipoli is the most beautiful game in the WW1 series yet, with excellent maps, fun new classes, and a continued focus on teamwork in order to win. The hard and dry landscapes of the Middle Eastern front are recreated with exquisite attention to detail, and the active player base of people taking it seriously enough to get the job done – but not so serious as to intimidate or scare off new players – is such a rare gem in modern gaming. It's those moments, though, when everyone is doing what needs to be done – whether it's laying down covering fire for an advance, or running from teammate to teammate healing their wounds as they dig in – that Gallipoli truly becomes a one-of-a-kind gaming experience."

recentItems.title: World of Warcraft Forever Is WoW “At Its Best” - Blizzcon 2026
recentItems.description: At Blizzcon 2026 we got to sit down with some lead game designers behind World of Warcraft Forever and chat about everything players can expect from this nostalgic entry to the long-live WoW franchise. Principal designer Kris Zierhut shares why WoW forever is an excellent time for new and lapsed players to jump in without fears of being left behind and everyone starting out on equal footing.
